scripts.build:extension: npm run build -w @lexiside/shared && npm run build -w @lexiside/extension
scripts.zip: npm run build -w @lexiside/shared && npm run zip -w @lexiside/extension
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lexiside/shared && npm run dev -w @lexiside/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lexiside/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @lexiside/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
